title: 第63章 元旦放假
content_zh:
第63章 元旦放假-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》

上一章

存书签

下一章

吴姜笑着说道，心里暗自盘算，等旧车修好，正好给老妈王雅琴开，老妈已经眼馋他的车很久了。

西装男连忙应道：“吴先生客气了，这都是我们应该做的。”

确认吴姜没有其他疑问后，西装男便礼貌告辞离开了。

吴姜将车开到车位，才哼着小曲，慢悠悠回家了。

一连几天，都没接到云川的电话，吴姜还特意去地府询问了一下，他们也没有任何的消息，不知道那只恶鬼躲到哪里去了。

这天，吴姜开车去了绿城大学，第二天就是元旦假期，李月芽有些行李要带回家，指名道姓的让吴姜来接自己。

最近这段时间，吴姜和李月芽两人抬杠少了，相处也融洽了不少，吴姜倒是很乐意去接她。

下午五点整，吴姜准时赶到绿城大学南门门口。

此时，南门门口已经挤满了放假的学生，拖着大大小小的行李箱，说说笑笑、打打闹闹地往外走，都是青春活力四射的样子。

吴姜找了个合适的位置停好车，就在门口等着李月芽，今天放假的缘故，吴姜想将车开进去都不行。

没等多久，就看到李月芽拖着一个行李箱，背着一个双肩包，从学校里走了出来。

旁边还有一个女同学，和李月芽有说有笑的走在一起。

吴姜迎上去，自然地接过李月芽手中的行李箱，李月芽旁边的女生，一脸八卦相的上下打量着吴姜。

“你好，你就是芽芽的竹马吧？我是芽芽的舍友，我叫王萌。”

女生大大方方的伸手，吴姜也伸出手，和她轻轻握了一下。

吴姜笑着回应：“什么竹马，我看是牛马才对。”

“能当我们芽芽的牛马，那可太幸福了，不知道羡慕死我们学校多少男同学了！”

王萌笑着打趣了一句，惹得李月芽羞红了脸，上前去捏她腰间的软肉。

吴姜只是在一边看着，也不上前说话，他可知道，有些女生，只要旁边有人壮胆，流氓起来，就没男人什么事了。

吴姜将李月芽的行李放进后备箱，然后就在一旁，等着李月芽和她舍友告别。

Wu Jiang said with a smile, thinking secretly that when the old car is repaired, it will be driven by his mother, Wang Yaqin, who has been coveting his car for a long time.

The man in the suit responded quickly: "Mr. Wu, you're welcome. This is what we should do."

After confirming that Wu Jiang had no other questions, the man in the suit politely said goodbye and left.

Wu Jiang drove the car to the parking space, hummed a little tune, and walked home slowly.

For several days, he didn't receive a call from Yunchuan. Wu Jiang even went to the underworld to inquire. They didn't have any news. They didn't know where the evil ghost was hiding.

On this day, Wu Jiang drove to Greentown University. The next day was the New Year's Day holiday. Li Yueya had some luggage to take home, so she asked Wu Jiang to pick her up by name.

During the recent period, Wu Jiang and Li Yueya had less arguments and got along much more harmoniously. Wu Jiang was happy to pick her up.

At five o'clock in the afternoon, Wu Jiang arrived at the south gate of Greentown University on time.

At this time, the south gate was already crowded with students on vacation, dragging suitcases of various sizes, chatting, laughing, and playing around, all looking youthful and energetic.

Wu Jiang found a suitable location to park the car and waited for Li Yueya at the door. Because of the holiday today, Wu Jiang couldn't even drive in.

Not long after, I saw Li Yueya walking out of school dragging a suitcase and carrying a backpack.

There was a female classmate next to her, talking and laughing with Li Yueya.

Wu Jiang stepped forward and took the suitcase from Li Yueya naturally. The girl next to Li Yueya looked Wu Jiang up and down with a gossipy look on her face.

"Hello, you are Ya Ya's bamboo horse, right? I am Ya Ya's roommate, and my name is Wang Meng."

The girl extended her hand generously, and Wu Jiang also extended his hand and shook her gently.

Wu Jiang responded with a smile: "What bamboo horse? I think it is an ox and horse."

"It would be such a blessing to be our Yaya's little nanny. I don't know how many male classmates in our school are so envious of me!"

Wang Meng smiled and joked, which made Li Yueya blush with embarrassment and stepped forward to pinch the soft flesh around her waist.

Wu Jiang just watched from the side and did not come forward to speak. He knew that for some girls, as long as someone next to them was emboldened and became gangsters, there would be nothing wrong with men.

Wu Jiang put Li Yueya's luggage into the trunk, and then stood aside, waiting for Li Yueya to say goodbye to her roommate.
